risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: inverted yield curve signals recession risk, VIX at crisis levels (85.1) indicates extreme market stress, strong dollar pressures multinational industrials, and earnings in 46 days adds event risk.

debate.key_bull_argument: Short-term RSI bullish momentum with supertrend and Ichimoku cloud breakout provides tactical entry signal near support (81.63), offering defined risk with fear-zone sentiment contrarian opportunity.
debate.key_bear_argument: Severe macro headwinds (inverted yield curve, VIX crisis at 85.1, strong dollar), overbought oscillators without volume confirmation, price below 200-EMA, weak ADX trend strength, high earnings risk in 46 days, and zero fundamental/smart money support make this a low-probability swing trade.
